units.source_text: 第二盘是在告别赛前五年，即昭和八年同吴清源五段的对局。

en.t: The second game was played five years before the farewell match, in other words in Showa 8, against Go Seigen, fifth dan.

units.source_text: 中盘下到一百五十手左右，局面微妙，却也看得出来白子处境不妙。

en.t: By the middle game, around the hundred and fiftieth move, the position was delicate, yet one could still see that White was in difficulty.

units.source_text: 这时名人走白160的绝着，胜了两目。

en.t: At this point the Master played the brilliant move White 160 and won by two points.

units.source_text: 风传这一出手不凡的绝着是名人的弟子前田六段想出来的。

en.t: Rumor had it that this extraordinary brilliant move had been devised by the Master's disciple Maeda, sixth dan.
Whether that was true or not is unknown.

units.source_text: 这期间，名人的弟子们大概也曾研究过这盘棋，发现了这白160吧。

en.t: During that time, the Master's disciples probably studied the game as well and discovered this White 160.

units.source_text: 正因为这是绝着，可能是弟子对名人说的，也可能是名人自己想出来的。

en.t: Precisely because it was such a brilliant move, it may have been suggested to the Master by a disciple, or the Master may have thought of it himself.

units.source_text: 除了名人及其弟子以外，其他人是不知道的。

en.t: Apart from the Master and his disciples, no one else knew.
